info = json.load(open("frag_info.json"))
els_f = info["els"]; cC = info["carbene"]; nN = info["nitrogens"]
F = np.load("frag_xyz.npy")

Cc = F[cC]; N1 = F[nN[0]]; N2 = F[nN[1]]
m = 0.5*(N1+N2)
u = Cc - m; u /= np.linalg.norm(u)          # outward (carbene lone-pair / M-binding) direction
v = np.cross(N1-Cc, N2-Cc); v /= np.linalg.norm(v)   # ring normal
w = np.cross(u, v)

def place(M, uM, t_hint):
    uM = np.array(uM, float); uM /= np.linalg.norm(uM)
    t = np.array(t_hint, float)
    t = t - (t@uM)*uM; t /= np.linalg.norm(t)
    wt = np.cross(uM, t)
    R = np.column_stack([uM, t, wt]) @ np.column_stack([u, v, w]).T
    Cc_t = np.array(M, float) + 2.05*uM
    X = (R @ (F - Cc).T).T + Cc_t
    return X

# backbone: buta-1,3-diyne-1,4-diide bridge, linear C4 chain along x at z=0
C1 = np.array([-1.91, 0, 0.0]); C2 = np.array([-0.69, 0, 0.0])
C3 = np.array([ 0.69, 0, 0.0]); C4 = np.array([ 1.91, 0, 0.0])
Au1 = C1 + 2.00*np.array([-np.cos(np.radians(12)), 0, -np.sin(np.radians(12))])
Au2 = C4 + 2.00*np.array([ np.cos(np.radians(12)), 0, -np.sin(np.radians(12))])
mid12 = 0.5*(C1+C2)
Cu  = mid12 + np.array([0,0,2.15])

uAu1 = np.array([-0.55,-0.25,-0.80]); uAu2 = np.array([0.55,0.25,-0.80]); uCu = np.array([0,0,1.0])
X1 = place(Au1, uAu1, (0,1,0))
X2 = place(Au2, uAu2, (0,1,0))
X3 = place(Cu,  uCu,  (0,1,0))

atoms = [("Au",Au1),("Au",Au2),("Cu",Cu),("C",C1),("C",C2),("C",C3),("C",C4)]
for X in (X1,X2,X3):
    for e,p in zip(els_f, X):
        atoms.append((e,p))

# sanity: bond distances
P = {i:p for i,(e,p) in enumerate(atoms)}
def d(i,j): return np.linalg.norm(P[i]-P[j])
print("Au1-Cc1", d(0,7), "Au2-Cc2", d(1,72), "Cu-Cc3", d(2,137))
print("Au1-C1", np.linalg.norm(Au1-C1), "Cu-C1", np.linalg.norm(Cu-C1), "Cu-C2", np.linalg.norm(Cu-C2))

# min inter-fragment heavy-atom distances
import itertools
def mind(Xa, Xb, ea, eb):
    best = 1e9
    for i,(pa) in enumerate(Xa):
        for j,(pb) in enumerate(Xb):
            if ea[i]=="H" or eb[j]=="H": continue
            dd = np.linalg.norm(pa-pb)
            best = min(best, dd)
    return best
print("min frag1-frag2", mind(X1,X2,els_f,els_f))
print("min frag1-frag3", mind(X1,X3,els_f,els_f))
print("min frag2-frag3", mind(X2,X3,els_f,els_f))
allX = np.array([p for e,p in atoms]); alle = [e for e,p in atoms]
# global min nonbonded heavy distance
best=1e9; pair=None
for i in range(len(atoms)):
    for j in range(i+1,len(atoms)):
        if alle[i]=="H" or alle[j]=="H": continue
        dd=np.linalg.norm(allX[i]-allX[j])
        if dd<best: best=dd; pair=(i,j,alle[i],alle[j])
print("global min heavy-heavy", best, pair)

with open("answer.xyz","w") as f:

    f.write("[(IPr)Au]2(mu-C4)[Cu(IPr)] cation, +1\n")
    for e,p in atoms:
        f.write(f"{e} {p[0]:.6f} {p[1]:.6f} {p[2]:.6f}\n")
